name: M3_CRS420MI_Get
description: Retrieve a single application message by its unique mail id. Application messages notify responsible users when changes affect their area, for example when related customer or supply records are updated or deleted. The operation includes the full header and context of the message, including receiver and sender, status, dates, short and long texts, bookmark and workflow context, and optional integration information (such as BOD settings for Infor ION).

inputParameters.name: MLID
inputParameters.description: Unique mail ID identifying the application message to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the application message.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the application message.

outputParameters.name: MLID
outputParameters.description: Unique mail ID of the application message.

outputParameters.name: REC2
outputParameters.description: User who is the receiver of the application message.

outputParameters.name: MTPE
outputParameters.description: Application message type identifying the message category from CRS424.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Current status of the application message.

outputParameters.name: TX30
outputParameters.description: Short description or subject text of the application message.

outputParameters.name: SEND
outputParameters.description: User who sent or created the application message.

outputParameters.name: REC3
outputParameters.description: Original receiver of the application message before any forwarding.

outputParameters.name: ADAT
outputParameters.description: Action date when the receiver is expected to act on the application message.

outputParameters.name: CDAT
outputParameters.description: Date when the application message was marked as completed.

outputParameters.name: RMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the application message is scheduled for removal.

outputParameters.name: MSGT

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the application message was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM

outputParameters.name: TXID

outputParameters.name: PGNM

outputParameters.name: PICC
